attempts.summary: Configured daily log rotation for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 via /etc/logrotate.d/inventory (daily, rotate 7, compress, copytruncate so the application keeps writing to the same file handle after rotation). Verified with a forced rotation that the inode is preserved and appends work post-rotation. Completed mandatory single-node restart evidence: captured healthy baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified logrotate config, log data, rotated archive, and crond all recovered intact.
